title: Vellicate
summary: VEL'LICATE, verb transitive [Latin vellico, from vello, to pull. It may be from the root of pull.] To twitch; to stimulate; applied to the muscles and fibers of animals; to cause to twitch convulsivel

inlines.v: VEL'LICATE, verb transitive [Latin vellico, from vello, to pull. It may be from the root of pull.] To twitch; to stimulate; applied to the muscles and fibers of animals; to cause to twitch convulsively.
